claim: On Wednesday 25 November 2026 the Senate lets the bill raising state payments into public health insurance for state-insured persons (+CZK 13bn for 2027) pass unchanged.

runs.yes_requires: Within the stated 25 November 2026 Europe/Prague window, the Czech Senate must adopt a resolution either approving the bill in the wording passed by the Chamber on 4 November 2026 or deciding not to deal with it. A report published later counts if it establishes that the decision was taken within the window.
runs.decided_by: The Czech Senate’s formal resolution, as recorded on senat.cz or reported by ČTK, ČT24, or another major Czech news outlet.

runs.yes_requires: On Wednesday 25 November 2026 (Europe/Prague), the Czech Senate must adopt a resolution either approving the bill raising state payments into public health insurance for state-insured persons (as passed by the Chamber on 4 Nov 2026) without changes, or deciding not to deal with the bill.
runs.decided_by: Official records on senat.cz or reports by ČTK, ČT24, or another major Czech news outlet.

runs.scenario: senat.cz shows the bill was adjourned or not voted, while ČTK or a Czech outlet of disputed major status reports that the Senate approved it unchanged or resolved not to deal with it; the criterion accepts either source and does not say which prevails if they conflict.
runs.yes_requires: Between 00:00 and 23:59 Europe/Prague on 25 Nov 2026, the Senate adopts a resolution approving (schvaluje) the Chamber bill that raises state payments into public health insurance for state-insured persons, in the wording the Chamber passed on 4 Nov 2026, or a resolution not to deal with that bill (nezabývat se).
runs.decided_by: The Senate resolution, as shown on senat.cz or reported by ČTK, ČT24, or another major Czech outlet; a later report counts if the decision was taken on 25 Nov.
